metadata.title: When you get 1 kill and suddenly think you’re the whole squad’s MVP
metadata.description:
I swear this kill was a complete accident.
My aim went on vacation but still scored.
Only VALORANT logic can explain this madness.
Click if you’ve ever carried with zero skill!

Click and laugh at my accidental MVP moment!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnyclips #shorts
